calibration_rule: NO target kill rate exists or is reported. The matrix is the attacker's measured ears: detected/missed per seeded category, localization misses kept separate (never converted into detections), false kills on clean controls recorded with their bases. An attacker that kills 100 percent of this corpus is as miscalibrated as one that kills 0 percent.
